facts.fact: PML Daily relaying the ministry says the National ICT Innovation Hub at Nakawa reopened in January 2024 and supported 133 start-ups, taking 102 products to market.
PML Daily says hubs followed at Kabale (June 2023) and Soroti (March 2024), then Muni and Busitema universities; programmes are not described for them.
facts.system: Kabale, Soroti, Muni and Busitema hubs
